game.name: Super Mario Bros. Category Extensions
game.rules:
## Approved hardware/software (please specify in the run comment):

### NES Categories

- Original NES, Famicom or FDS
- Original NES or Famicom with EverDrive N8 (Pro), PowerPak, or KrzysioCart
- Wii, Wii U, Switch and 3DS Virtual Console, GameBoy Advance
- Nestopia, BizHawk (NesHawk core only), OpenEmu (Nestopia core only), MesenRTA
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Input display and frame counter are required for emulators that have those features built in
- NES Classic Edition
- Analogue NT Mini
- RetroUSB AVS
- MiSTer

### SNES Categories

- Original SNES or Super Famicom
- Original SNES or Super Famicom with Super EverDrive or SD2SNES/FXPAK Pro
- Wii All-Stars Rerelease
- Snes9x, BizHawk, MesenRTA-S
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen-S you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Analogue Super Nt
- MiSTer

*If you do not see a specific platform on this list, then it is not permitted.*

## Global Rules

- Game audio must be present in the recording for the duration of the run.
- All times require a video on a publicly visible site.  YouTube and Twitch are fine.  Personal storage sites such as Google Drive and Dropbox are discouraged.  If the videos are removed or no longer accessible, the run is subject to removal from the leaderboard.
- Anything that you cannot do with an original and unmodified NES, brick controller and SMB1 cartridge is prohibited.  Including but not limited to:
- Turbo
- L + R
- Savestates
- Debugging tools (RAM watch, Lua scripts, ROM Debuggers)
- Altering the game speed (FPS)
- Using a bad ROM (missing title screen, different graphics, etc.)
- Pausing externally such as with Wii (U)/Switch Home Menu or pause hotkeys on emulators.
- You may be asked to provide us additional data upon request to assist us in our verification process.  Splits, input files (if applicable), entire attempt sessions and local recordings mostly cover what we'd ask for and it's a good idea to hang on to those.
- Custom color palettes with changes such as a red sky are discouraged unless they assist with any visual impairment. If you do use one, please submit the ".pal" file used. Do not make two different colours the same when creating a custom palette.
- Runs must begin in the first quest unless otherwise stated.
- For emulator submissions, holding L+R must be equal to holding nothing (neutral). Last input and other types of SOCD resolution are banned.

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
No Wall Jump  
No Wrong Warp  
No Flag Pole Glitch  
No Bullet Bill Glitch  
No Wall Clip (Mario fully inside the wall)  

Old leaderboard can be found here: http://www.twingalaxies.com/scores.php?scores=5717&ref=fbshare

We have since abandoned the old timing method. Timing now starts the frame "400" appears on TIME, just as with all other categories.

Approved hardware/software (please specify in the run comment):
- Original NES, Famicom or FDS
- Original NES or Famicom with Everdrive or Powerpak
- Wii, Wii U, Switch and 3DS Virtual Console
- FCEUX, Nestopia, Bizhawk, OpenEMU
- NES Classic Edition
- Analogue NT Mini

Important rules (please read before submitting):
- All times require a video.
- Turbo/Autofire and left+right/up+down are banned.
- Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.

categories.name: 1-1 as Fire Mario
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Complete 1-1 as Fire Mario

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - First frame Mario grabs the Flagpole.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 8-4 IL
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Complete 8-4 as fast as possible.  You must start at small Mario.  Practice ROMs and savestates are permitted for this category.  If you use a savestate, it must be at least a few frames before 400 appears on the timer. Disabling music is permitted, but game audio must be audible for the duration of the recording.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

**Submissions must allow getting a precise framecount!**

categories.name: Minus World
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Get to World -1 and enter the pipe at the end of the level as fast as possible.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame Mario becomes invisible after entering the pipe in -1.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: Beat 5-4
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 5-4.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 1 Warp
categories.rules:

## Timing

End - The frame Mario becomes invisible after entering the pipe in 8-4.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

You must softlock the game as fast as possible.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The first frame Mario grabs the flagpole at the end of the level you softlock in.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited.

**Your video must show the softlock that occurs for runs to be validated.**

**You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 10 Walljumps
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Walljump off of a solid object 10 times as fast as possible. 

**Jumping inside a wall and hitting the block directly above you does not count as a walljump.** 

**Cramming yourself between a wall and the edge of the screen and jumping from there also does not count as a walljump.**

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame Mario becomes airborne after the 10th walljump.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. 

**You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: Both Quests
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat both quests of the game as fast as possible by any means necessary.

Pushing button B or using the continue code A + Start is allowed.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4 in the second quest.


Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 11x Any%
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible by any means necessary 11 times in a row.

## Timing

Start - Power-on/Reset (or game select if you are using a combo cartridge)

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4 on the 11th run.

**Time between each axe grab and game reset/select will not count, you will have 10 seconds to restart, otherwise the time between reset will be added to prevent stalling.**

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 144 Fireworks
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*



## Goal



You must finish every level that has a flagpole with 6 fireworks, this is achieved by ending the level with 6 on the last digit of the in-game timer.



**In the event you miss fireworks in a level, you must game over and use the continue code to retry that level, you do not need to trigger 6 fireworks in levels you already have.**



## Timing



Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.



End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.





Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: AISSON
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible using the Game Genie code AISSON, or AIISON.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.


Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: Over the Flagpole
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Touch the ground on the right side of the flagpole by jumping over the flagpole.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame Mario touches the ground (or on the block in the castle that you can stand on) on the right side of the flagpole.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: 10 Lives
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Obtain 10 total extra lives as quickly as possible. You must play on the NES/Famicom or FDS version, Super Mario All-Stars/Super Mario Collection is not permitted due to starting the player with more lives.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame that Mario's live count increments to 10; this is the fifth frame that the "1UP" graphic is visible on-screen.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

For additional details regarding the retiming of this category, please refer to this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cW8KKuaXUok

categories.name: 10 Lives No Infinites
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Obtain 10 total extra lives as quickly as possible without the use of infinite 1-up tricks. You must play on the NES/Famicom or FDS version, Super Mario All-Stars/Super Mario Collection is not permitted due to starting the player with more lives.

Examples of infinites:
-Infinite koopa or buzzy beetle stomps (using stairs, blocks, or vines)
-Infinite shell kick chains using a lakitu
-Infinite farming through death

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame that Mario's live count increments to 10; this is the fifth frame that the "1UP" graphic is visible on-screen.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

For additional details regarding the retiming of this category, please refer to this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cW8KKuaXUok

categories.name: Pacifist
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible without interacting with all organic enemies that appear on screen walking on the ground/in a pipe/cloud/underwater.

This includes stomping, killing with fire/star power, hitting a block under an enemy, and kicking a shell to kill enemies.

Enemies that are despawned before appearing on screen are not included.

Organic Enemies include:

- Goombas, 
- Koopas, 
- Buzzy Beetles, 
- Piranha Plants (Including in the Warpzones), 
- Lakitu and any spinys it may throw (including the initial spiny in 8-2), 
- Bloopers
- All types of Cheep Cheeps,
- Hammer Brothers, 
- Bullet Bills,
- Bowser.

**Enemies simply walking into a pit does not count as killing them.**

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.rules:

This includes stomping, killing with fire/star power, hitting a block under an enemy, and kicking a shell to kill enemies.

Enemies that are despawned before appearing on screen are not included.

- All types of Cheep Cheeps,

**Enemies simply walking into a pit does not count as killing them.**

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.name: Anti-Pacifist
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible, while interacting with all organic enemies that appear on screen walking on the ground/in a pipe/cloud/underwater in a manner that would disqualify a normal Pacifist run.

This includes stomping, killing with fire/star power, hitting a block under an enemy, and kicking a shell to kill enemies.

**Enemies that are despawned before appearing on screen are not included.**

Organic Enemies include:

- Goombas, 
- Koopas, 
- Buzzy Beetles, 
- Piranha Plants (Including in the Warpzones), 
- Lakitu and any spinys it may throw (including the initial spiny in 8-2), 
- Underwater Bloopers/Cheep Cheeps, 
- Hammer Brothers, 
- Bowser.

*Flying Cheep Cheeps, Bullet Bills, and Podoboos are not included.*

Enemies simply walking into a pit does not count as killing them.
The Despawning plant in Room 1 of 8-4 must be Killed.
The invisible plant in 8-4 water section must be killed.
Bowser must be killed with fire.

## Timing

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. **You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.**

categories.rules:

## Timing

End - The frame the 500th coin you collect is no longer on-screen and added to your coin counter, if you collected your 500th coin from a multi-coin block then the timing ends when the coin is added to your coin counter.

categories.name: All Powerups
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Collect every power-up from every power-up block in the game.

Powerup blocks are defined as:

- Any block containing a Super Mushroom/Fire Flower 
- Any block containing a Star Man.

games.name: Super Mario Bros. Category Extensions
games.rules:
## Approved hardware/software (please specify in the run comment):

### NES Categories

- Original NES, Famicom or FDS
- Original NES or Famicom with EverDrive N8 (Pro), PowerPak, or KrzysioCart
- Wii, Wii U, Switch and 3DS Virtual Console, GameBoy Advance
- Nestopia, BizHawk (NesHawk core only), OpenEmu (Nestopia core only), MesenRTA
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Input display and frame counter are required for emulators that have those features built in
- NES Classic Edition
- Analogue NT Mini
- RetroUSB AVS
- MiSTer

### SNES Categories

- Original SNES or Super Famicom
- Original SNES or Super Famicom with Super EverDrive or SD2SNES/FXPAK Pro
- Wii All-Stars Rerelease
- Snes9x, BizHawk, MesenRTA-S
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen-S you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Analogue Super Nt
- MiSTer

*If you do not see a specific platform on this list, then it is not permitted.*

## Global Rules

- Game audio must be present in the recording for the duration of the run.
- All times require a video on a publicly visible site.  YouTube and Twitch are fine.  Personal storage sites such as Google Drive and Dropbox are discouraged.  If the videos are removed or no longer accessible, the run is subject to removal from the leaderboard.
- Anything that you cannot do with an original and unmodified NES, brick controller and SMB1 cartridge is prohibited.  Including but not limited to:
- Turbo
- L + R
- Savestates
- Debugging tools (RAM watch, Lua scripts, ROM Debuggers)
- Altering the game speed (FPS)
- Using a bad ROM (missing title screen, different graphics, etc.)
- Pausing externally such as with Wii (U)/Switch Home Menu or pause hotkeys on emulators.
- You may be asked to provide us additional data upon request to assist us in our verification process.  Splits, input files (if applicable), entire attempt sessions and local recordings mostly cover what we'd ask for and it's a good idea to hang on to those.
- Custom color palettes with changes such as a red sky are discouraged unless they assist with any visual impairment. If you do use one, please submit the ".pal" file used. Do not make two different colours the same when creating a custom palette.
- Runs must begin in the first quest unless otherwise stated.
- For emulator submissions, holding L+R must be equal to holding nothing (neutral). Last input and other types of SOCD resolution are banned.
